newsitem.title: USA: International Electronics Q3 income lower.
newsitem.headline: International Electronics Q3 income lower.

text.p: International Electronics Inc said Friday that it returned to profitability in its fiscal third quarter after streamlining parts of its manufacturing operations. However, net income for the quarter was 71 percent below its level during the same time last year.

International Electronics, a maker of security equipment and systems, said in a statement that net income for the quarter ending May 31 was $10,263 compared to $35,915 last year at this time. Earnings per share fell by half to $0.01 in the last quarter.

The company's president, John Waldstein told Reuters, "we had a 2 to 3 percent drop in our second quarter profit margins because we lost efficiencies in our manufacturing process after substantial growth last year. It's picking up now and the numbers reflect that."
